data.title: Identity Not Found
data.narrative_purpose: Introduce Elena Vasquez in a state of extreme distress, revealing the core conflict of her identity being erased, and establish the series' paranoid, tech-driven atmosphere.
data.emotion: Paranoia, dread, despair, exhaustion, clinical detachment
data.camera_style: Tight shot on trembling hands, slow widen to reveal chaotic war room, close-up on distorted screen reflection (flickering glitch), pull back to wide shot emphasizing isolation. Inspired by Mr. Robot's precise, often isolating framing and True Detective's atmospheric wide shots.
data.color_palette: Desaturated blues, stark blue-white screen glow, deep oppressive shadows, hints of warm amber from incidental lights
data.lighting: Dominant harsh blue-white screen light, deep practical shadows, minimal ambient light. Reminiscent of Sicario's high contrast and selective illumination.
data.visual_motif: Screens, reflections (especially distorted), data interfaces, wires, claustrophobic interiors
data.music: Low, persistent electronic drone, subtle bass pulse, almost subliminal

data.title: Three Days Earlier
data.narrative_purpose: Provide a clear temporal transition to a flashback sequence, signaling a shift to the origin story of Elena's crisis.
data.camera_style: Fade to black, holding on black
data.music: Electronic drone fades out, replaced by clean, sterile ambient tone
